Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire (Japanese: ポケットモンスターR・S(ルビーサファイア) Pocket Monster R S (Ruby and Sapphire)) is a shōnen Pokémon manga created by Kosaku Anakubo. It is a sequel to the original Pokémon Pocket Monsters and is succeeded by . The story follows the adventures of and his Pokémon ( , and ) in Hoenn. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick. 

Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire was published in six bound volumes by Shogakukan in Japan. The series was translated into English by Chuang Yi in Singapore as Pokémon RS.
